newsitem.title: UK: Firm sterling sends quiet UK grains futures down.
newsitem.headline: Firm sterling sends quiet UK grains futures down.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures ended down on currency moves after a quiet day's trading.
Total wheat volume for the day was just 79 lots.
Most active month was May, with 47 lots. It last traded at 98.60 stg, down 0.50 stg.
Total barley volume was just 11 lots.
Market sentiment was again completely dominated by currency movements as rising sterling against other European currencies pushed prices down.

A physical market still subdued by New Year holidays provided no real impetus to futures, traders said. They hoped for more activity after the weekend. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
